Nil.

An area of high pressure continues to cover the British Isles and Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, occasionally moderate in the southwest of the area Wednesday morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 for a time Wednesday evening and at first Wednesday night, then occasionally touching 6 in the south of the area Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, building slight or moderate through Wednesday evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
